note: Один короткий настоящий ролик VOA Learning English (американский английский) на урок: где сегодняшняя форма звучит в живом диалоге, плюс крошечное задание. Ролики проверены на официальном канале VOA Learning English (YouTube); реплики для shadowLine взяты из расшифровок на learningenglish.voanews.com. start/end пока охватывают весь ролик (точных таймкодов сцены нет). Уроков без проверенного ролика здесь нет — приложение использует запасной вариант.

path-be.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 2: Hello, I'm Anna!
path-be.source: VOA Learning English — Let's Learn English, Lesson 2

question.prompt: Откуда Анна и в какой квартире она живёт?
question.answer: Из маленького города; квартира C2

path-be.lookFor: Найди, где говорят am / is / are: I am from…, She is Anna, Marsha is my roommate
path-be.shadowLine: I am from a small town.

path-articles-basic.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 4: What is it?
path-articles-basic.source: VOA Learning English — Let's Learn English, Lesson 4

question.prompt: Что Анна ищет в сумке и что достаёт вместо этого?
question.answer: Ручку; достаёт книгу, игрушку, подушку, карту, лампу

path-articles-basic.lookFor: Найди a перед каждой новой вещью: a pen, a book, a map, a lamp
path-articles-basic.shadowLine: It is not a pen. It is a book.

path-this-that.title: Lesson 14: How About This?
path-this-that.source: VOA Learning English — Let's Learn English, Lesson 14

question.prompt: Куда Анна собирается вечером и кто помогает ей выбрать одежду?

path-this-that.lookFor: Найди this / these и that / those: this dress, these clothes, those clothes, that looks great

path-present-simple.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 12: Meet My Family
path-present-simple.source: VOA Learning English — Let's Learn English, Lesson 12

question.prompt: Чем занимается тётя Лавендер?
question.answer: Любит садоводство и делает ложки

path-present-simple.lookFor: Найди -s у she/he: She loves gardening and makes spoons; и вопрос What does Uncle John do?
path-present-simple.shadowLine: She loves gardening and makes spoons.

path-possession.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 15: I Love People-Watching!
path-possession.source: VOA Learning English — Let's Learn English, Lesson 15

question.prompt: Как Анна описывает начальницу?
question.answer: Невысокая, со светлыми прямыми волосами, носит очки

path-possession.lookFor: Найди have и has: You have brown eyes, I have blue eyes, She has straight, light hair

path-questions-basic.title: Lesson 16: Where Are You From?
path-questions-basic.source: VOA Learning English — Let's Learn English, Lesson 16

question.prompt: Откуда туристы, у которых Анна берёт интервью?
question.answer: Из Бангладеш, Китая и Ирана

path-questions-basic.lookFor: Найди вопросы со словом-вопросом: What is your name? Where are you from? What languages do you speak?

research-spelling-numbers.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 3: I'm Here!
research-spelling-numbers.source: VOA Learning English — Let's Learn English, Lesson 3

question.prompt: Почему Анна сначала не дозванивается до Марши?
question.answer: Набрала не тот номер: 555-8689 вместо 555-8986

research-spelling-numbers.lookFor: Послушай, как номер называют по одной цифре: five-five-five, eight-nine-eight-six

natural-a1-welcome.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 1 - Welcome!
natural-a1-welcome.source: VOA Learning English — Let's Learn English, Lesson 1

question.prompt: Как пишется имя Анны?
question.answer: A-N-N-A, с двумя n

natural-a1-welcome.lookFor: Найди приветствие и имя по буквам: Nice to meet you; Is that A-N-A? — No. A-N-N-A

path-present-continuous.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 7 - What Are You Doing?
path-present-continuous.source: VOA Learning English — Let's Learn English, Lesson 7

question.answer: Пишут, записывают передачу, читают для эфира

path-present-continuous.lookFor: Найди am / is / are + -ing: What are you doing? I'm writing. I'm reading for my show.

path-there-is.title: Lesson 11: This Is My Neighborhood
path-there-is.source: VOA Learning English — Let's Learn English, Lesson 11

question.prompt: Где Анна берёт наличные на марки?
question.answer: В банке прямо за ней

path-there-is.lookFor: Найди Is there…? и There is…: Is there a post office near here? There is a bank behind you.
path-there-is.shadowLine: Is there a bank near here?

path-countability.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 30: Rolling on the River
path-countability.source: VOA Learning English — Let's Learn English, Lesson 30

question.answer: Фунт креветок и дюжину крабов; $49.95

path-countability.lookFor: Сравни How much shrimp? (не считаем) и How many crabs? (считаем)

path-place-time.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 6 - Where Is the Gym
path-place-time.source: VOA Learning English — Let's Learn English, Lesson 6

question.prompt: Где на самом деле спортзал?
question.answer: Напротив комнаты отдыха, рядом с почтовой комнатой, за вестибюлем

path-place-time.lookFor: Найди слова места: across from, next to, behind

path-requests-can.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 20: What Can You Do?
path-requests-can.source: VOA Learning English — Let's Learn English, Lesson 20

question.prompt: Кем в итоге решает стать Пит?
question.answer: Писателем — у его блога много подписчиков

path-requests-can.lookFor: Найди can / can't без to: Can you drive? I can't cook. I can be a writer!

extended-a1-order.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 23: What Do You Want?
extended-a1-order.source: VOA Learning English — Let's Learn English, Lesson 23

question.prompt: Что заказывает Джонатан, когда креветки закончились?
question.answer: Говядину

extended-a1-order.lookFor: Найди, как заказывают и исправляют заказ: I'll have the shrimp… Okay, I'll have the beef then; и сдачу: here is your change

research-ordering-checkout.title: How to Pronounce: Methods of Payment -- Cash or Credit Cards
research-ordering-checkout.source: VOA Learning English — How to Pronounce

question.prompt: Какое слово остаётся без -s, а какое получает -s в вопросе об оплате?
question.answer: cash — без -s; credit cards — с -s

research-ordering-checkout.lookFor: Найди вопросы об оплате: Do you take cash? Do you take credit cards? Do you prefer cash or credit cards?

extended-a1-chat.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 17: Are You Free on Friday?
extended-a1-chat.source: VOA Learning English — Let's Learn English, Lesson 17

question.prompt: Когда Анна и Марша наконец идут в кино?
question.answer: В субботу днём, сразу — Марша переносит дела на воскресенье

extended-a1-chat.lookFor: Найди, как договариваются о времени: Are you busy this Thursday at 6pm? How about on Wednesday night? Let's go!
extended-a1-chat.shadowLine: Are you busy on Friday night?

path-instructions.title: Lesson 10: Come Over to My Place
path-instructions.source: VOA Learning English — Let's Learn English, Lesson 10

question.prompt: Напротив чего находится дом Анны?
question.answer: Напротив большого универмага

path-instructions.lookFor: Найди указания, которые начинаются с глагола: Exit the Metro and turn right. Then walk straight ahead.
path-instructions.shadowLine: Exit the Metro and turn right.

path-adjectives-frequency.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 18: She Always Does That
path-adjectives-frequency.source: VOA Learning English — Let's Learn English, Lesson 18

question.prompt: Что начальница запрещает Анне в новостях?
question.answer: Показывать чувства — только факты

path-adjectives-frequency.lookFor: Найди слова частоты перед действием: We are always reading facts. We never show our feelings. She rarely talks… she often says…

extended-a1-day.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 13: Happy Birthday, William Shakespeare!
extended-a1-day.source: VOA Learning English — Let's Learn English, Lesson 13

question.prompt: Почему Анна сегодня смотрит кукольный спектакль?
question.answer: Сегодня день рождения Шекспира

extended-a1-day.lookFor: Сравни привычку и «сегодня»: I never watch puppet shows. But today I am watching a puppet show.

path-past-simple.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 24: Yesterday Was Amazing
path-past-simple.source: VOA Learning English — Let's Learn English, Lesson 24

question.prompt: Куда Анна попала, когда пошла прогуляться с работы?
question.answer: На Смитсоновский фестиваль народной культуры (баскская культура)

path-past-simple.lookFor: Найди прошедшее время: I was at work, I wanted a break, I walked, I saw, It was a festival

research-ending-s-ed.title: Everyday Grammar TV: Past Tense -ed with Taylor Swift
research-ending-s-ed.source: VOA Learning English — Everyday Grammar TV

question.prompt: Когда -ed звучит как отдельный слог /ɪd/?
question.answer: Если глагол кончается на звук t или d: wanted, decided, needed

research-ending-s-ed.lookFor: Слушай -ed: /ɪd/ в wanted, decided; просто /d/ после звонкого звука или гласной

path-dates-directions.title: How to Pronounce: Take First, Second, Third
path-dates-directions.source: VOA Learning English — How to Pronounce

question.answer: Walk that way. It will be the second door on the right / Take the first left

path-dates-directions.lookFor: Найди порядковые числа с left и right: the second door on the right, take the first left
path-dates-directions.shadowLine: Walk that way. Take the first left.

path-past-continuous.title: Lesson 42: I Was Minding My Own Business
path-past-continuous.source: VOA Learning English — Let's Learn English, Lesson 42

question.prompt: Где Анна на самом деле повредила руку?
question.answer: В торговом автомате, когда доставала пакет чипсов

path-past-continuous.lookFor: Найди was/were + -ing: She was yelling… Two robbers were grabbing her bag. While I was running, I tripped and fell.

path-could-able.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 43: Time for Plan B
path-could-able.source: VOA Learning English — Let's Learn English, Lesson 43

question.prompt: Почему друзья не могут помочь Анне?

path-could-able.lookFor: Найди could и be able to: Would you be able to come downtown? I wish I could. Could you give me $20?

path-future-simple.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 34: What Will I Do?
path-future-simple.source: VOA Learning English — Let's Learn English, Lesson 34

question.prompt: Кем Анна в итоге идёт на вечеринку?
question.answer: Рок-звездой

path-future-simple.lookFor: Найди will и might: You will get a job… — I might get a job? She will say yes!

path-future-plans.source: VOA Learning English — Let's Learn English, Lesson 22

question.answer: О летних каникулах

path-future-plans.lookFor: Найди going to для плана: What are we going to talk about? First, we're going to introduce the subject.

path-suggestions-offers.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 38: She’s my best friend!
path-suggestions-offers.source: VOA Learning English — Let's Learn English, Lesson 38

question.answer: Переехать и жить с ней и Маршей; Пенелопа не может оставить родной город и работу

path-suggestions-offers.lookFor: Найди предложения: Let's go to my apartment. Why don't you move here and live with me and Marsha?

research-schwa-wordstress.title: How to Pronounce: King of Vowel Sounds
research-schwa-wordstress.source: VOA Learning English — How to Pronounce

question.prompt: Почему автор называет нейтральный гласный «королём»?

research-schwa-wordstress.lookFor: Послушай безударный /ə/ — короткий, расслабленный, без ударения
research-schwa-wordstress.shadowLine: It is the neutral vowel sound.

path-vowels-russian.title: How to Pronounce: Games with Vowel Sounds
path-vowels-russian.source: VOA Learning English — How to Pronounce

question.prompt: Какие два гласных сравнивают в игре?
question.answer: /ɪ/ как в city, Italy и /i/ как в see, sleep

path-vowels-russian.lookFor: Слушай разницу: короткий /ɪ/ (city) и долгий /i/ (see, sleep)
path-vowels-russian.shadowLine: Vowel sounds are very important in American English.

path-present-perfect.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 48: Have You Ever...?
path-present-perfect.source: VOA Learning English — Let's Learn English, Lesson 48

path-present-perfect.shadowLine: I've never been to any zoos!

path-possessive-pronouns.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 37: Let's Agree to Disagree
path-possessive-pronouns.source: VOA Learning English — Let's Learn English, Lesson 37

question.answer: Фила — туриста из маленького города

path-comparatives.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 31 Take Me Out to the Ball Game
path-comparatives.source: VOA Learning English — Let's Learn English, Lesson 31

question.prompt: Что в итоге оказалось быстрее автобуса, такси и велосипеда?
question.answer: Метро

path-comparatives.lookFor: Найди -er + than: A taxi is faster than a bus. Being early is better than being late.
path-comparatives.shadowLine: A taxi is faster than a bus.

path-adverbs-manner.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 40: The Woods Are Alive (corrected subtitles)
path-adverbs-manner.source: VOA Learning English — Let's Learn English, Lesson 40

question.prompt: Какую роль Анна в итоге получает?
question.answer: Дерево в спектакле «The Woods Are Alive»

path-adverbs-manner.lookFor: Найди -ly после действия: speak more loudly, walk slowly and quietly, it fits you perfectly

path-obligation.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 21: Can You Come to the Party?
path-obligation.source: VOA Learning English — Let's Learn English, Lesson 21

question.prompt: Почему Анна сначала отказывается идти на вечеринку?
question.answer: Ей надо получать водительские права — сдавать тесты

path-obligation.lookFor: Найди have to / has to: I have to get my driver's license. Everyone has to bring something.
path-obligation.shadowLine: I have to get my driver's license.

path-zero-first.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 41: Teamwork Works Best With a Team
path-zero-first.source: VOA Learning English — Let's Learn English, Lesson 41

question.prompt: Что не так с первым графиком у мисс Уивер?
question.answer: Он перевёрнут вверх ногами

path-zero-first.lookFor: Найди if + настоящее, will + действие: If you look at this chart, you will see something good.
path-zero-first.shadowLine: If you look at this chart, you will see something good.

path-gerund-infinitive.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 47: How Can I Help?
path-gerund-infinitive.source: VOA Learning English — Let's Learn English, Lesson 47

question.prompt: Почему машина Пита не заводится?
question.answer: Закончился бензин

path-gerund-infinitive.lookFor: Найди глагол + to и глагол + -ing: I was planning to visit some friends. I like helping.

research-apologies-remedies.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 8: Are You Busy?
research-apologies-remedies.source: VOA Learning English — Let's Learn English, Lesson 8

question.prompt: Что ждёт Анну в кабинете начальницы в 5 вечера?
question.answer: Вечеринка-сюрприз — и работа за ней остаётся

research-apologies-remedies.lookFor: Найди извинения: Sorry about yesterday. I want to say I'm sorry for yesterday.

path-relative-basic.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 29: A Long Time Ago
path-relative-basic.source: VOA Learning English — Let's Learn English, Lesson 29

question.prompt: Кем Анна и Марша мечтали стать в детстве?
question.answer: Анна — президентом США, Марша — астронавтом

path-relative-basic.lookFor: Найди who и where, которые уточняют: people who live here; Ford's Theatre, where a man shot President Abraham Lincoln
path-relative-basic.shadowLine: When I was a little girl, I was not like other children.

path-connectors-basic.title: Everyday Grammar TV: 'But' a Small, Common, Important Word
path-connectors-basic.source: VOA Learning English — Everyday Grammar TV

question.prompt: Что добавляет в предложение маленькое слово but?
question.answer: Противопоставление и интерес: соединяет две части с подлежащим и сказуемым

path-connectors-basic.lookFor: Найди but между двумя частями: It's a small, common word… But it adds excitement and contrast to sentences.

extended-a2-story.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 28: I Passed It!
extended-a2-story.source: VOA Learning English — Let's Learn English, Lesson 28

question.prompt: С какой попытки Анна сдала экзамен по вождению?
question.answer: Со второй

extended-a2-story.lookFor: Слушай историю в два слоя: события (It started fine, I passed) и фон (You were driving too slow, There were cars in the street)

path-everyday-phrasal.title: Let's Learn English - Level 2 - Lesson 2: The Interview
path-everyday-phrasal.source: VOA Learning English — Let's Learn English Level 2, Lesson 2

question.prompt: Какое новое задание мисс Уивер даёт Анне?
question.answer: Снова вести программу и работать в паре с очень непохожим на неё человеком

path-everyday-phrasal.lookFor: Найди фразовые глаголы: giving new assignments out, go back to hosting, team up with someone
path-everyday-phrasal.shadowLine: I want you to go back to hosting and reporting.

path-email-basic.title: Everyday Grammar TV: Making Polite Requests in Email
path-email-basic.source: VOA Learning English — Everyday Grammar TV

question.prompt: Кому Фейт пишет письмо и почему?
question.answer: Ветеринару её кошки — там перепутали лекарство

path-email-basic.lookFor: Найди вежливые просьбы с could / would: Would you mind helping me…? Would you be able to refill…?
path-email-basic.shadowLine: Would you mind helping me with something?

path-present-perfect-continuous.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 50: Back to School
path-present-perfect-continuous.source: VOA Learning English — Let's Learn English, Lesson 50

question.prompt: О чём на самом деле должен был быть доклад Анны?
question.answer: О насилии в городе (violence), а не о скрипках (violins)

path-present-perfect-continuous.lookFor: Найди have/has been + -ing с for и since: I have been writing… since last night. How long has the class been waiting? I've been studying here since 2015.

path-past-perfect.title: Let's Learn English Level 2 Lesson 3: He Said - She Said
path-past-perfect.source: VOA Learning English — Let's Learn English Level 2, Lesson 3

question.prompt: Почему Анна и Пит опоздали на встречу?
question.answer: Каждый винит другого: Пит ждал особый кофе, Анна кормила птиц

path-past-perfect.shadowLine: By the time she had fed all the birds, we were late.

path-future-continuous.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 45 This Land is Your Land
path-future-continuous.source: VOA Learning English — Let's Learn English, Lesson 45

question.prompt: Куда Анна по ошибке везёт Маршу вместо Южной Дакоты?
question.answer: В Северную Дакоту

path-future-continuous.lookFor: Найди will be + -ing: We will be driving for a long time. We'll be eating lunch in about 2 hours.
path-future-continuous.shadowLine: We will be driving for a long time.

path-word-formation.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 39: It’s Unbelievable!
path-word-formation.source: VOA Learning English — Let's Learn English, Lesson 39

question.prompt: Что случилось с волосами Анны после Hair Be Good?
question.answer: Стали выглядеть плохо — средство не помогло

path-word-formation.lookFor: Найди приставки с отрицанием: untidy, uncomfortable, inexpensive, imperfect, unbelievable, dishonest
